prediction_step: 1-based, every step from 1 through H must appear exactly once for every candidate/seed and every supplied bundle origin
required_before_freeze: only calibration and decision samples/predictions, plus 999 refit row-null losses per registered gate candidate; no test file or test truth path
required_before_score: frozen route hash, test samples and predictions with the identical task/spec/bundle signatures
candidate_policy: Only registered gate candidates with complete refit null evidence may enter the gate. Diagnostics and the older N+S+Q+F are not gate candidates.
rejection: Reject duplicate, missing, extra, shifted or reordered origin grids; mixed task/fold/scenario/signature/config/scale; nonfinite prediction; short horizon; unverified or preview bundle. Never silently inner-join.
